main_text.p: pto tramite, donec ad metā perventum sit, malevolorum artibus avellamur. Omnibus placere impossibile est; nam ut optime Iul. Cæs. Scal. Epi-dorp. l. 3.

Non sæpè Deus placet, & tu placere credis? Nobis igitur satis est, doctis & probis placuisse, cum aliis ferram reciprocare non vacat. Semotis affectibus judicabit sera posteritas, nam Pascitur in vivis livor, post fata quiescit.

page.notes: The left-margin reference "dorp. l. 3." is printed beside the line "Iul. Cæs. Scal. Epi-" and is read as its continuation; placement is uncertain. Some errata-list digits and words are doubtful at this scan resolution (notably "Tesdid", "pritium", "6:.6." and "usurpetur"); marked [?] where unsure. The verse italics are judged from the scan. The title line "INTRO." is a catchword, not a heading.
